_about: Everything a merchant can sell. Each island's merchant sells one family. Every item comes in four rarities; the arrays below are [common, uncommon, rare, legendary]. A rune's rarity is its condition: broken, cracked, fine, pristine. Strong suits and weaknesses are on purpose: no item saves you from everything.

slots.name: Gear
slots.help: Worn all the time. One at a time. Yours for good: it absorbs one hit a level, one more for each part fitted at the workbench and one for a trinket, and it's whole again every level.

slots.name: Spell
slots.help: Press Space to cast. One at a time. Yours for good: its charges come back every level, and the Arcanum Spire's lectern levels it up.

slots.name: Snack
slots.help: Goes in your pocket, which holds four. Press 1 to 4 in a level to eat one; each bite spends a charge.

slots.name: Familiar
slots.help: Comes along beside you into every level and never wears out. One at a time; choose it before a level.

slots.name: Rune
slots.help: Yours for good: a rune never wears out or burns up. One is active at a time, shown under your hearts, and its good side and its bad side both work in every level. Swap it or take it off whenever you're not in a level.

slots.name: Canister
slots.help: Extra hearts in a jar. Its purple hearts and armor are lost first and never come back; when they're all gone, so is the jar. One at a time.

items.name: Kite Shield
items.does: Blocks a hazard or enemy you run into and shoves it aside.
items.strong: Rocks, bees, fleas, ghosts, brambles, spikes, popsicles
items.weak: No help against walls, fire, lightning or blasts, and a shoved bee comes right back.
items.legend: Rocks bounce off without wearing it down.

items.name: Arming Sword
items.does: Kills any enemy you hit: bees, fleas, ghosts, rival snakes. Against a boss it cracks armor.
items.weak: Hitting a hazard knocks it aside but snaps the blade. Useless against walls.
items.legend: Hazards never snap the blade: they only cost one use.

items.name: Bulwark Helm
items.does: Your head bounces off a wall instead of crashing.
items.strong: Walls, inner walls, the edges of the board
items.weak: Does nothing at all against hazards or enemies.
items.legend: Spikes and brambles shatter against it, and that costs nothing.

items.name: Ember Cloak
items.does: Shrugs off the elements: fire, lightning strikes, bomb blasts and frost.
items.weak: Cloth, not steel: rocks, enemies and walls go straight through it.
items.legend: Fire never wears it down.

items.name: Thorn Mail
items.does: Armors your body: biting your own tail passes through, and anything that bites your body gets pricked.
items.strong: Your own tail, rival snakes and bosses biting your body
items.weak: Your head is bare. Anything you run into face-first still hurts.
items.legend: Your own tail never wears it down.

items.name: Force Field
items.does: A bubble that soaks up hazards and enemies for a few seconds.
items.weak: Walls pop it instantly.
items.legend: Also bounces you off one wall.

items.name: Fireball
items.does: A homing fireball that burns the nearest enemy or hazard. On a boss it cracks a heart of armor.
items.strong: Bees, ghosts, brambles, bombs, rival snakes, boss armor
items.weak: Can't burn rocks or walls, and never touches a boss's bare heart.
items.legend: Each fireball splits and burns two targets.

items.name: Blink
items.does: Teleports your whole snake forward, straight through whatever is in the way.
items.weak: Only goes straight ahead, and it won't jump you into a wall.
items.legend: You're untouchable for a second after landing.

items.name: Frost Nova
items.does: Freezes every hazard and enemy in place.
items.weak: A boss only freezes for half as long, and frozen things still hurt to touch.
items.legend: A frozen boss loses stamina while it's frozen.

items.name: Apple Call
items.does: Apples slide toward your head for a while.
items.weak: Not a scrap of protection.
items.legend: Called apples are worth double.

items.name: Hearty Stew
items.does: Eat it to heal hearts.
items.weak: Can't heal past your full hearts, and does nothing if you have none.
items.legend: Heals two hearts.

items.name: Honey Bread
items.does: Eat it to grow back an armor plate.
items.strong: Anyone with armor plates from the Warding Willow
items.weak: Useless if your armor is whole, or if you have none.
items.legend: Grows back two plates.

items.name: Tinker's Pie
items.does: Eat it to patch up your gear: worn uses come back.
items.strong: Keeping a good shield or sword alive
items.weak: Does nothing without gear, or if it's good as new.
items.legend: Patches four uses back.

items.name: Spice Jerky
items.does: Eat it to put charges back in your spell.
items.weak: Does nothing without a spell, or if it's fully charged.
items.legend: Two charges back.

items.name: Phoenix Tart
items.does: Eat it, and the next blow that would end you this level won't: you rise again with a moment of safety.
items.weak: Only one second chance per bite, and you come back with very few hearts.
items.legend: Comes back with three hearts.

items.name: Sugar Plum
items.does: Eat it and apples are worth double for a few seconds.
items.weak: No protection at all, and wasted if no apples are near.
items.legend: Apples are worth triple instead.

items.name: Fire Pepper
items.does: Eat it and fire, embers and heat can't hurt you for a while. You move a little faster too.
items.strong: Fire, embers, lava, the Cinder Crown
items.weak: Does nothing for cold, rocks or enemies, and the speed is hard to steer.
items.legend: Lightning can't hurt you either.

items.name: Mint Leaf
items.does: Eat it and you slow right down for a few seconds.
items.strong: Tight mazes, fast levels, getting out of a jam
items.weak: Slow is slow: timed goals and chasers catch up.
items.legend: Hazards slow down with you.

items.name: Glow Berry
items.does: Eat it to light up the dark around you.
items.weak: Useless anywhere that isn't dark.
items.legend: Hidden goals and relics glow too.

items.name: Rock Candy
items.does: Eat it and your head smashes straight through the next rocks or hazards it hits.
items.weak: Walls are still walls, and enemies still bite.
items.legend: Every smash is worth points.

items.name: Royal Jelly
items.does: Eat it and enemies lose interest in you for a few seconds.
items.weak: Hazards don't care what you ate, and bosses only pause.
items.legend: Enemies that touch you while it lasts are stunned.

items.name: Lantern Firefly
items.does: Fetches a nearby apple for you every few seconds, and lights up the dark.
items.weak: Can't fight anything.
items.legend: Fetched apples count double.

items.name: Snip the Crab
items.does: Snips a bee, flea or bramble that gets close.
items.weak: Won't touch ghosts, fire or anything magical.
items.legend: Also snips spikes and rocks.

items.name: Shellby the Turtle
items.does: Takes one hit for you, then needs a while to pull its shell back together.
items.strong: Any one hit from a hazard or enemy
items.weak: Slow to recover, and it can't stop walls.
items.legend: Starts every level with its shell ready, plus one extra.

items.name: Puff the Pufferfish
items.does: Puffs up and pushes chasing enemies away from your head.
items.weak: Hazards that sit still don't care.
items.legend: Bosses lose stamina when it pushes them.

items.name: Sir Seahorse
items.does: Haggles a bigger reward out of every win you bring it along for.
items.weak: A gentleman. Does not fight.
items.legend: Also finds a loot trinket on every win.

items.name: Rune of Plenty
items.does: More apples on the board, and more points for each one.
items.weak: Hazards come faster.

items.name: Rune of Stillness
items.does: You move slower, which gives you time to think.
items.weak: Points are worth less.

items.name: Rune of Fortune
items.does: Much more money from every level.
items.weak: Fewer hearts.

items.name: Rune of Fury
items.does: Bosses tire faster and your bites hit them harder.
items.weak: You take more damage.

items.name: Rune of Echoes
items.does: If you die, you come back once and keep going.
items.strong: Hard levels you just want done
items.weak: The level pays less if the echo saves you.

items.name: Rune of Haste
items.does: Every point is worth more.
items.weak: You move faster.

items.name: Rune of Iron
items.does: Extra armor plates in every level, even with no hearts.
items.weak: Every apple makes you longer.

items.name: Rune of Vigor
items.does: Extra hearts in every level.
items.weak: Hazards come faster.

items.name: Rune of the Magpie
items.does: Trinkets turn up far more often.
items.weak: Points are worth less.

items.name: Rune of the Sage
items.does: Free casts of your spell in every level: they don't spend its charges.
items.weak: Your spell recharges slower between casts.

items.name: Rune of Greed
items.does: A chance of a gem every time you win a level.
items.strong: Saving up for skins and themes
items.weak: Much less money from every level.

items.name: Rune of Calm
items.does: Hazards come slower.
items.weak: Apples are worth fewer points.

items.name: Rune of Grace
items.does: After every hit you're safe for a moment.
items.strong: Busy boards full of things to bump into
items.weak: Fewer hearts.

items.name: Heart Canister
items.does: Purple hearts on top of your own, lost first. They don't refill between levels, and the jar is gone when they are.
items.strong: Hard levels and boss fights: every purple heart is a free mistake
items.weak: Never sold by merchants. Found on the board now and then, or won from a quest.
items.legend: Five plates of shiny purple armor instead of hearts, four pieces each.
